mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, we have clear skies at the Verona Public Library under a Waning Gibbous moon. For space fans, the International Space Station will be visible for two minutes starting at 5:07 AM, rising over Verona High School in the northwest and moving toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, reaching about halfway up the sky.

Starting November 20, remember that alternate side parking is in effect until April 1, meaning you must park on the side of the street corresponding to the calendar day. Also, please note that the Verona Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, bring the family to the Main Street Trick-or-Treat event and catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, head downtown for the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or catch some music at Paddy Mac's.
In a recent report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a man who was subsequently arrested for an O W I, first offence.
Today's flavor is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
